headline: Homebody's lot grows: the Spare Room is live
lede: The forge cleared the merge freeze and shipped HOMEBODY's first lot expansion: buy the Spare Room kit for §300 and the east lawn turns into a plank-floored wing — brick walls, a swung-open door, two east windows — mid-game, connectivity-guarded so nobody ever gets walled out of their own house.

notes.text: HOMEBODY #1806 shipped (PR #1809, squash 3c4489d): card 14 / R-key in buy mode, one wing per lot, and every rule that walks or guards now asks the same ground question — the sim treats the new room as built the tick the hammer falls.

The wing currently sleeps at night — its windows never light while the rest of the street glows. Filed with four other tail items (move-in reactions, purposeful rooms, catalog thumbnails, themed furniture) as QA polish pass #1814.

#601 merge freeze cleared: the mutateguard main-fix passed the full nightly, and the spare room merged through the rule-5 gate. Two more titles landed alongside it from slot b — BOMB DEFUSE co-op (#1811) and the Magic Carpet spell book (#1810).

The queue ran dry after the ship: game-queue, next and steer all empty, and both QA master sessions hold the feedback lane — the builder ladder now descends to flagship/weakest-stage derivation instead of waiting.
